agent_note: Two registers in the quote set: a large body of present-tense essayistic civic commentary (gnomic, 22 of 38) that is quotability bias plus what reads as non-fiction-style political argument, and a smaller thriller narration strand that is first-person/third-person present (9 of 12 event quotes). The past minority is memory/backstory (q02627 iterative recollection, q02644 primaries backstory) plus q02621's specific past clause inside an otherwise essayistic passage. Dialogue marks survive well in this book (q02624, q02625, q02640 all carry them), so unmarked speech-register quotes were judged by vocative/direct address (q02630) rather than by tags. q02613, q02623 and q02632 are past-tense frame verbs citing real-world figures with no story-world referent -- kept gnomic under the argument-by-analogy exception, flagged rather than decided silently.
